implementation: PR #202 implementation; debug Rust and instrumented real Tauri/WebKit dev frontend
scope: Real Tauri IPC and native WebKit DOM. Harness dispatches DOM input/click and waits for committed selector/text at 16 ms intervals. Frame intervals are requestAnimationFrame deltas. No providers, source writes or physical cold-disk claim. Parallel implementation/build activity was present. Samples are retained, not cherry-picked.
